title: char_create
summary: MSUI's create screen is a deliberate port of current Benilla's char_create: per-race class lists from CharBaseInfo, dial ranges from CharSections/CharHairGeosets/CharacterFacialHairStyles, byte-exact CMSG_CHAR_CREATE, GlueStrings faction/race/class paragraphs, starting outfit on the 3D preview, drag-to-rotate, success re-enum with the new row armed, and the exact class/look/cancel/create glue sound gestures. ChrRaces fields 26/27/28 drive sex-specific facial and hair customization tokens, and CharCreateUiLaw resolves every localized dial caption without changing MSUI's established glue layout. The wire is fully covered (3/3 opcodes).

openItems.text: The per-race dial-5 label rename (ChrRaces HAIR_/FACIAL_HAIR_ tokens - 'Markings'/'Horns'/'Tusks' per race) is self-documented as deferred; a generic label shows instead.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: CharCreateCatalog reads the build-5875 ChrRaces customization tokens from fields 26/27/28; CharCreateUiLaw resolves all five captions through GlueStrings with exact generic fallbacks, including the sex-specific fifth dial. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Glue click sounds are absent (self-documented: no glue audio subsystem on this screen).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: CharCreateUiLaw owns the exact gsCharacterCreationClass/Look/Cancel/CreateChar cues. Every race/sex/class click, appearance arrow, randomize, accepted Back/Escape and accepted Create route through the pre-world shared SoundEntries player. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify all eight races and both sexes show their localized Hair Style/Color and Facial Hair/Markings/Piercings/Tusks caption variants and that switching race/sex refreshes immediately without moving the established dial geometry.

Live-verify before world entry that race/sex/class choices play gsCharacterCreationClass, dials/randomize play gsCharacterCreationLook, Back/Escape plays gsCharacterCreationCancel, and a valid accepted create plays gsCharacterCreationCreateChar exactly once.
